# 3. Validation for empty collections / no valid pixels / invalid values

    print("C1")

if all((st['count'] == 0) for st in stats):
    print_line("No valid pixels in region after processing.")
    print("C2")
    raise SystemExit

if all((not valid_temp(st['maxK'])) for st in stats):
    print_line("Calculation produced None/invalid temps for both windows.")
    print("C3")

# 4. Reporting concise evidence

print_line(f"Dataset used: {ds_name}")

# 5. Decision
any_over_50 = any(valid_temp(st['maxK']) and (st['maxK'] >= thresh_k) for st in stats)
print("A" if any_over_50 else "B")
